title: Concept: Content-Security-Policy script-src allows unsafe-hashes
description: `'unsafe-hashes'` lets an injected inline handler run when its text matches a hash the policy lists, so the policy is not the nonce-only barrier that its other keywords suggest.
applicability: Responses that send Content-Security-Policy with an explicit script-src directive.
risk: Inline handlers that match a listed hash execute in the page origin despite the nonce-based policy; MEDIUM because the attacker must reuse handler text the policy already trusts.
